comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Bright earrings"

Beginning with Chapter 3: Cetus, this can randomly be obtained from treasure chests in the bonus map unofficially designated "Fiddler's Green" that is found in the Sea of Wonders #1, Lighthouse of Alexandria version. More details on the SoW page. Item stats:

Durability 100
Formality 5
Disguise 20
Attack Power 10
Defense 20
Ecological research +2
Archaeology +2
Search +3
Unisex, total fame to equip 5k 5000

Cheers.

Source/pics: fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1694.html

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: Officially named "Shining Earring", you can obtain this at the green rare map. Well, Guilder already gave a wonderful details about it above lol. Seems like a slight improved version of Great Lighthouse Earrings
